description: This Java source file defines the VaultProvider class, a custom Android DocumentsProvider that manages encrypted storage of documents and directories, including key management, document creation, deletion, and content read/write operations with encryption and decryption on demand.

classes.name: VaultProvider
classes.description: Custom Android DocumentsProvider that encrypts document metadata and content, manages document lifecycle, and handles key management for secure storage.

classes.name: ExtrasMatrixCursor
classes.description: Extension of MatrixCursor to include extra Bundle data for additional metadata or info.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loads or generates encryption keys, and sets up the root document.

methods.name: loadOrGenerateKeys
methods.description: Loads existing symmetric encryption keys or generates new ones, deriving data and MAC keys for encryption and authentication.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns the root directory information for the document provider.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Retrieves an EncryptedDocument instance for a given document ID.

methods.name: includeDocument
methods.description: Adds document metadata to a cursor for display or processing.

methods.name: isChildDocument
methods.description: Checks if a document is a child of a given parent document.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document or directory with specified MIME type and display name.

methods.name: initDocument
methods.description: Initializes a document with metadata and optional content.

methods.name: renameDocument
methods.description: Renames a document by updating its metadata.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document and its children, and removes references from parent directories.

methods.name: deleteDocumentTree
methods.description: Recursively deletes a document and all its children.

methods.name: deleteDocumentReferences
methods.description: Removes references to a document from parent directories.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific document.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Lists child documents of a directory.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a document for reading or writing, starting background threads for content transfer.

methods.name: startRead
methods.description: Starts a thread to read and decrypt document content, providing a pipe for streaming.

methods.name: startWrite
methods.description: Starts a thread to encrypt and write document content from a pipe.

methods.name: maybeRemove
methods.description: Removes a value from a JSONArray if present.
